title: POST {oauth.token_endpoint} form fields (application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
description: The store exchanges the code for an access token. Client authentication is HTTP Basic (client_id:client_secret, each form-encoded first, RFC 6749 §2.3.1); no Commerce API key or signature. The store keeps no token: it redeems the access token with POST customers (verified_via oauth) at once.
